|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “[Pilot] 3: any Star Destroyer. ''Tyrant'' and •••Death Squadron Star Destroyers are power + 1, deploy - 3 to Lennox's location, and their permanent pilots have ability of 2.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Captain Lennox (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots.: any Star Destroyer. ''Tyrant'' and •••Death Squadron Star Destroyers are deploy -3 and power +1 here, and their ability-1 permanent pilots are replaced by ability-2 permanent pilots.” '''What changed:''' “[Pilot] 3:” → “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots.:”; added “deploy -3 and”; “+ 1, deploy - 3 to Lennox's location,” → “+1 here,”; added “ability-1”; “have ability of 2.” → “are replaced by ability-2 permanent pilots.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 32. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Captain Lennox]].
* Later text: [[Captain Lennox (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
